craft_notes: Sthāyin: vīra of stated proof — design inference through lacunae; gaps sung as gaps; FIRST VERSE of the work sets the house voice (terminal doctrine words; owner verdict required). Objection voiced as objector per prose (UNC); both-horns kept. Rejected: (a) siddhāntin voice → killed: reply v09 confirms objector. Read aloud: NEI-ther POTT-er NOR-lord … OR-else UN-proved AC-cord.

lines: Neither potter nor Lord shows agreement here —
since for him, contradiction would follow — or else unproved accord.
l4.sanskrit_cite: na kulālena neśenāpyanvayo'tra pradarśyate yato viruddhatāsya syādasiddhānvayatāpi vā

reads_against.argmap: Does concomitance hold for potter or Lord? → Objection stated: the concomitance fails on both horns — opposition or unprovedness.
c1_essence: Bodies bespeak a conscious maker, like pots: the design inference stated through lacunae (vv1-2).
Variety marks wisdom; matter can't arrange; makers proved prove the Lord — answering neither-potter-nor-Lord with conscious-only pervasion shown (vv5-9).
